name: Imagera LLM API
description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint for 320+ language models from 48 labs with one API key, billed per token, with streaming.
notes: Works with the official OpenAI SDKs by changing the base URL to https://api.imagera.ai/llm/v1. The model list with per-token prices is public and needs no key: https://api.imagera.ai/llm/v1/models. Paid, billed per token.
